subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Shanti heard the children __who were shouting outside__

options.text: who were thrashing in the open air
who were flaying in the open air

solution:
The correct answer is, **'who were screaming outdoors'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Screaming and shouting are used as synonyms sometimes, but **shouting involves speaking loudly** while** screaming involves no proper words**.

 
 
• Example - ***The little boy was screaming and then started crying***.
 
• Example -*** The students were shouting as there was no teacher in the class***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **Shanti heard the children who were screaming outdoors**.
